goal: Review the Release 2 cloud deployment report: the deployment workflow run, the deployed frontends, the smoke tests, the cloud security configuration, and that the AI services stay disabled by default
_note: The report is the cloud-deployment-evidence artifact of the latest cloud-deployment.yml run (gh auth login first), else docs/reports/release-2/cloud-deployment-results.md. CLOUD_URL optionally names a deployed frontend to probe.
rules: The deployment is Azure Container Apps; only shared-ui and the frontends are public, backends and databases are internal.
Images are pulled with a managed identity, never a registry password.
AI-Mode, MCP, RAG and the Multi-Agent Server are not deployed; the cloud profile turns every AI feature off by default.
The deploy job runs in the `production` environment, whose required reviewer is the human release decision.
A deployment that succeeded is not automatically ready to release: the checks and the human decide.
